title: eludite.forge.pull input
description: One pull request (opening it in the Pull Requests window): the description, author, base and head, commits, files changed with additions and deletions, review threads anchored to the head commit's lines with their resolution, reviews, checks and mergeability. `threads: unresolved` keeps only the threads an author must still answer (with their file, line and comments): the agent's loop starts here. Cached like eludite.forge.pulls. Read. The repository is the workspace's (its remote `origin`, or `remote`), detected as eludite.forge.detect does; every call runs on the forge worker off the UI thread with a timeout and stops when canceled. A call that needs a token when none is stored for the host fails with `sign_in_required: <host>`: the person signs in (Git > Sign in to <forge>); an agent cannot.

number.description: The number (GitHub, GitLab's `iid`, Azure DevOps, Forgejo, Gitea). Give `number` or `id`.

id.description: The item's `id` as a list answered it; Tangled's items have only this (their AT-URI). Give `number` or `id`.

remote.description: The git remote to read (default `origin`, else the only remote).

refresh.description: Wait for a fresh answer from the forge instead of answering from the cache at once.
